title: Sakura Internet hack exposes data of up to 1.36 million accounts
summary: Japanese cloud and data center service provider Sakura Internet disclosed that hackers accessed its sales management system, where customer contract and membership information is stored. BleepingComputer could not find a ransomware or data extortion threat actor claiming the attack on Sakura.
